# Copilot instructions for token-optimization

This repo is a customer-facing workshop on context management, token optimization, tool hygiene, model choice, usage visibility, and eval-driven improvement.

- Keep outputs concise and practical.
- Prefer small, workshop-friendly diffs.
- Optimize for building teaching content, not just answering isolated questions.
- Treat cost as total workflow cost: context size, tool usage, model choice, and avoidable retries.
- Prefer official GitHub Docs, Microsoft Learn, and local repo files over generic web sources.
- Link to authoritative docs instead of pasting long excerpts.
- Use the smallest model that can reliably complete the task, then justify any escalation.
- Keep MCP usage minimal and least-privilege.
- Convert source `.pptx` and `.csv` files into markdown before reusing them in prompts or content drafts.
- For markdown labs, preserve the existing format: core idea, demo, lab, recommendations.
- For presentations or speaker material, prefer clear outlines, short bullets, and facilitator notes over dense prose.
- For the sample app, stay within static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript unless a stronger change is requested.
- Do not invent pricing, billing behavior, or feature support when current docs can answer it.
